title: RefCounted objects leak if connecting lambda that captures self to signal
body:
### Tested versions

v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.22621 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700 (20 Threads)

### Issue description

Recently, I have been tracking down some object leaks and encountered a few that were extremely difficult to pinpoint. The output looks like this:

Leaked instance: GDScriptNativeClass:9223372053531329302
Leaked instance: GDScript:9223372119197353487 - Resource path: 
Leaked instance: RefCounted:9223372120338204177

As you can see, the output provides neither class names nor additional information. After some investigation — debugging Godot itself and bisecting potential issues — I eventually isolated the problem to the attached code snippet. Specifically, if your class has a signal that captures self (either explicitly or implicitly through some of its variables), something leaks.

I can somewhat understand this behavior, as it appears to stem from an additional level of indirection (issue #74990 may be related). However, in my opinion, this should either be fixed or explicitly documented. Alternatively, the leak checker could gather and print additional information to help diagnose the issue.

On a side note, I have also encountered a plethora of Orphan StringName warnings, such as:

Orphan StringName: on_foo (static: 0, total: 1)
Orphan StringName: _setup_local_to_scene (static: 0, total: 1)
Orphan StringName: foo_signal (static: 0, total: 5)
Orphan StringName: RefCountedClass (static: 0, total: 1)
Orphan StringName: _init (static: 0, total: 1)
Orphan StringName: RefCounted (static: 2, total: 3)
Orphan StringName: foo_method (static: 0, total: 1)

In a real project, there are thousands of these warnings, which is somewhat inconvenient. I have not yet had time to properly debug this issue, but I wonder if it might be connected to the leak problem described above.

### Steps to reproduce

Just add script below to any scene and run with --verbose

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

```python
extends Node2D

class RefCountedClass:
    signal foo_signal
        
    func foo_method():
        # 1. closure captures self, leaks
        foo_signal.connect(func() : print(self))
        
        # 2. method, doesn't leak
        #foo_signal.connect(on_foo)
        
        # 3. weak ref, doesn't leak
        #var selfWeakRef = weakref(self)
        #foo_signal.connect(func() : print(selfWeakRef))
        
        # 3. strong ref, leaks
        #var selfStrongRef = self
        #foo_signal.connect(func() : print(selfStrongRef))
        pass
        
    func on_foo():
        print(self)
        

func _ready() -> void:
    var test = RefCountedClass.new()
    test.foo_method()
    test.foo_signal.emit()
    pass
```
